The '''House Juoni''' was a family that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Juonii was an important aristocratic family on Kaikielius. With the rival families [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] and [[House Vahali/Legends|House Vahali]], it consituted the [[Triad (Great Houses)|Triad]], which had an important voice on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

During the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] in [[17,000 BBY]], the Juonii extended their interests into the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and sided with [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. However, after Alsakan was defeated, the Juonii were stripped of their Expansion Region assets and the heads of the House were imprisoned in [[Centax-1 Maximum Correctional]], on [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]].
